&reftitle.parameters;
options
This parameter is a bitmask for the following options:
debug_print_backtrace options
DEBUG_BACKTRACE_IGNORE_ARGS
Whether or not to omit the "args" index, and thus all the function/method arguments, to save memory.
DEBUG_BACKTRACE_PROVIDE_OBJECT
Accepted for compatibility with debug_backtrace, but has no effect: the generated backtrace is rendered as a string and the "object" entry is never printed.
Each printed argument value is truncated to zend.exception_string_param_max_len bytes (15 by default) when it is a string; an array is printed as Array, an object as Object(ClassName), and a resource as Resource id #N. An argument declared with the SensitiveParameter attribute goes through the same object placeholder, printing as Object(SensitiveParameterValue) instead of its real value.
limit
This parameter can be used to limit the number of stack frames printed. By default (limit=0) it prints all stack frames.
